title: Google Confirms Training Gemini4 Large Model: Commitment to Prioritize Computing Power for AGI, Future May Release New Models Monthly
excerpt: At the Alphabet Q2 2026 Earnings Call, CEO Sundar Pichai revealed the latest progress on the next-generation cutting-edge large model "Gemini4." In the context
content_html:
At the Alphabet Q2 2026 Earnings Call, CEO Sundar Pichai revealed the latest progress on the next-generation cutting-edge large model "Gemini4." In the context of the delayed release of Gemini3.5Pro, which was originally scheduled for June and is still in the partner testing phase, Google has launched the largest pre-training program in its history to fully develop Gemini4, ensuring a leading position in the competition for general artificial intelligence (AGI).

In terms of technology and product layout, Google has recently released Gemini3.6Flash, 3.5Flash-Lite, and 3.5Flash Cyber for security purposes. To address previous shortcomings in code generation and agent (Agent) capabilities, Google has significantly improved the performance of the 3.x Flash series through iterative optimization. To ensure the training of cutting-edge models, Google has clearly prioritized maintaining a leading position in AGI by allocating tensor processing unit (TPU) computing power, and has built a larger foundational model for Gemini4. Pichai stated that Google's future model delivery rhythm will significantly accelerate, with the goal of achieving an iteration frequency of "releasing a new model almost every month."

Industry experts expect Gemini4 to officially debut between November and December this year. Faced with increasingly fierce AI competition, Google has demonstrated its determination to maintain its position in the forefront of technological innovation by prioritizing core computing power and accelerating the iteration cycle. This also indicates that the development of large models in the industry is rapidly entering a new stage characterized by frequent updates and efficient collaboration.

content_html_zh:
在 Alphabet 2026 年第二季度财报电话会议上，首席执行官 Sundar Pichai 透露了下一代尖端大型机型“Gemini4”的最新进展。 在原定于6月份发布且仍处于合作伙伴测试阶段的Gemini3.5Pro推迟发布的背景下，谷歌启动了有史以来最大规模的预训练计划，全面开发Gemini4，确保在通用人工智能（AGI）的竞争中处于领先地位。

在技​​术和产品布局方面，出于安全考虑，谷歌近期发布了Gemini3.6Flash、3.5Flash-Lite、3.5Flash Cyber​​。 为了解决之前代码生成和代理（Agent）能力方面的缺陷，Google通过迭代优化显着提升了3.x Flash系列的性能。 为了保证前沿模型的训练，谷歌明确优先考虑通过分配张量处理单元（TPU）计算能力来保持在AGI领域的领先地位，并为Gemini4构建了更大的基础模型。 皮查伊表示，谷歌未来的模型交付节奏将显着加快，目标是达到“几乎每个月发布一个新模型”的迭代频率。

业内专家预计Gemini4将于今年11月至12月间正式亮相。 面对日益激烈的AI竞争，谷歌通过优先核心算力、加快迭代周期，展现了保持技术创新前沿地位的决心。 这也预示着行业大机型的发展正在迅速进入更新频繁、协作高效的新阶段。
